content.short: Maximize Your Passive Income With Cardano's First DeFi Ecosystem.
content.description:
Acta Finance is the first DeFi Ecosystem on the Cardano blockchain that introduces affiliate incentives and brings transparency by utilizing decentralized price feeds to execute liquidations for margin traders on ADAFi Swap. Every action on Acta Finance is performed on the Cardano blockchain, which are audited by our partners. Our goal is to introduce new passive earning opportunities to the DeFi industry for the community to benefit from, on top of the already existing ones. The ADAFI Token brings 5 utilities that boosts the ADA Finance ecosystem. Our mission is to fight manipulated liquidations of centralized entities by offering derivatives in a decentralized way on ADAFi Swap, overlooked ADA Finance Oracle. Acta Finance believes in trust and transparency in the crypto industry! Acta Finance contributes to the DeFi evolution by connecting peer-to-peer lenders to margin requests on ADAFi Swap. IDO Launchpad: Cardano IDO Launchpad incubates projects that build on Cardano. Acta Finance Oracle: Decentralized price feed aggregator that provides transparency. ADAFi Swap: Swap protocol built on Cardano for user friendly high frequency usage. Derivatives: Margin Trading on ADAFi Swap. Social Trading: Automatically copy the trades of a trade leader. Acta Finance offers multiple opportunities for users to earn a passive income by combining the most rewarding DeFi features. Staking: Up to 30% APR. Farming: Stake your Liquidity Points to earn a share of the reward pool. DAO: Take the required amount and claim your DAO title to boost your passive earnings. Lending: Feed margin requests on ADAFi Swapand earn up to 2% daily. Affiliate Program: Affiliate network and address milestones to incentivize growth and activity.
